_comment: Project coupling for waymark. The engine ships neutral defaults; this file is what points it at a particular codebase. TWO KB ROOTS, and that is deliberate: the first is the SAMPLE project's knowledge base, which every example in the README runs against; the second is waymark's knowledge about ITSELF. They merge into one index and one search -- which also makes this repository a live demonstration of the multi-root split it documents. Keep project names, paths and dialects here, never in .tools/*.py.
